start_command: cd backend && export DATABASE_PATH=./eval-j.db JWT_SECRET=eval-secret-at-least-32-bytes-long-0123456789 PROVIDER_TIMEZONE=Asia/Kolkata APP_ENV=dev && rm -f eval-j.db && uv run alembic upgrade head && uv run uvicorn telemed.api.app:create_app --factory --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 > ../eval-j-server.log 2>&1
start_note: Backend :8000 and Vite :5173 (proxies /api to 127.0.0.1:8000). Setup as in groups G/H/I (sqlite3 admin insert with argon2 hash, POST /api/admin/doctors for doctors A and B with several slots, register patients P1..P2, book via POST /api/appointments). Time-dependent and status states (inside/outside the 60 min window, CHECKED_IN/IN_PROGRESS/COMPLETED/CANCELLED/NO_SHOW, notes) are arranged by sqlite3 UPDATE of slots/appointments with safe margins or via the real doctor flow. 409 UI states use Playwright route interception where the real condition is hard to reproduce. E6-S2 checks are CLI-only (no servers needed); negative scratch checks are done in a temporary copy of the repo and violations are never committed. Frontend gates: cd frontend && npm test (change-window, appointment-card, allowed-actions unit tests), npm run lint, npm run typecheck must pass.

api_checks.note: setup/regression: GET /health 200; admin login; onboard doctors A and B (several slots each); register patients P1, P2; book appointments; doctor A drives one of P1's appointments to COMPLETED and posts two notes. Failure blocks the group.

Regression of UI-facing shapes (API-22/24/25): GET /api/appointments/mine as P1 -> items with status, allowed_actions, join_url, change_deadline, fee as string, ascending start_time; POST cancel (API-24) -> 200 CANCELLED; POST reschedule {new_slot_id} to another AVAILABLE slot of the same doctor (API-25) -> 200 with new start_time; reschedule to another doctor's slot or the same slot -> 409 SLOT_UNAVAILABLE; cancel or reschedule inside 60 min (sqlite3 slot margin, e.g. 59 min) -> 409 CHANGE_WINDOW_CLOSED; cancel at >= 90 min margin succeeds. Confirms UI-facing shapes only.

GET /api/appointments/{id}/notes as P1 on the COMPLETED appointment (API-28) -> 200 with two notes ascending note_id; PUT/PATCH/DELETE on /api/appointments/{id}/notes/{note_id} (API-29) -> 405 METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED with Allow: GET (no edit/delete exists server-side, so the UI must not offer them); another patient's GET -> 404.

GET /api/patients/me/profile as P1 -> 200 (API-06); PUT with changed phone -> 200 returning the new phone (API-07); GET again -> new phone persists; PUT with age 0 -> 422 (backs the field-error UI check).

Regression (API-15, API-02, API-26): GET /api/doctors/me/queue?date=YYYY-MM-DD as doctor A -> 200 body {date, timezone, items, total}. The provider timezone label field is 'timezone' (IANA name, e.g. 'Asia/Kolkata'), NOT 'provider_timezone'; 'provider_timezone' is the field of GET /api/config (API-02), which must also return 'Asia/Kolkata' for this start_command. Items ascending by start_time, each with allowed_actions; BOOKED row allowed_actions includes CHECKED_IN. The UI shows the label derived from this server value (no hard-coded zone). POST /api/appointments/{id}/status CHECKED_IN -> 200; invalid transition -> 409 INVALID_APPOINTMENT_STATE (status unchanged); NO_SHOW before start -> 409 INVALID_APPOINTMENT_STATE; bad date -> 422.

GET /api/doctors/me/slots as doctor A (API-12); PUT .../block (API-13) on AVAILABLE slot -> 200 BLOCKED; PUT .../unblock (API-14) -> 200 AVAILABLE; block on a BOOKED slot -> 409 (UI disables the control, server stays authoritative); unblock on a non-BLOCKED slot -> 409 INVALID_SLOT_STATE.

POST note on a BOOKED appointment as doctor A (API-27) -> 409 INVALID_APPOINTMENT_STATE; on COMPLETED -> 201; GET notes lists it (API-28); PUT/PATCH/DELETE on /api/appointments/{id}/notes/{note_id} -> 405 (API-29).

cd backend && uv run pytest --cov on the full suite -> exit 0. pyproject.toml [tool.coverage.report] has fail_under = 80 and a separate enforced domain-layer threshold of 95 (coverage.py has one fail_under, so a second report/step or script is needed for the domain package). Scratch copy with a skipped test module (or --cov-fail-under=100) -> non-zero exit, and the domain gate fails when domain coverage < 95.
api_checks.expect_status: exit 0 on full suite; non-zero when below threshold

GET /api/doctors/me/queue as patient -> 403; without token -> 401; POST /api/appointments/{id}/status as doctor B (not the appointment's doctor) -> 404.
Status POST on an appointment already CHECKED_IN with CHECKED_IN again -> 409 INVALID_APPOINTMENT_STATE; a follow-up GET queue returns the unchanged status (the data the UI refetches).

steps: log in as patient P1; reach My appointments via in-app navigation (route path not fixed by spec)

F107: click Reschedule on an eligible card, pick another open slot of the same doctor (only that doctor's slots listed), confirm -> card shows the new time; GET /api/appointments/{id} agrees

F109: open profile, change phone, submit -> success message visible; reload the page -> new phone value displayed; invalid value (age 0) shows a field error and no success message

content_rules: E5-S3: routes for My appointments, notes and profile registered in frontend/src/app/routes.tsx under the PATIENT role guard; AppointmentCard renders status as text and 'Join video visit' only for BOOKED, CHECKED_IN, IN_PROGRESS; Cancel/Reschedule enabled state driven by server allowed_actions/change_deadline, the 60-minute text only explanatory
E5-S3: notes view has no edit/delete controls or inputs; 409 responses shown as an inline message (no alert/console); API calls go through api/client.ts; types from types/contracts.ts; no 'any'

E5-S4: QueueRow renders only buttons listed in allowed_actions; Mark NO_SHOW disabled with explanation before start; times formatted via config/format.ts with the provider timezone from the queue response field 'timezone' (or GET /api/config provider_timezone), no hard-coded zone; NoteForm rendered only for COMPLETED; slot block control disabled for BOOKED slots; DOCTOR route guard on /queue and doctor pages
E5-S4: 1280px-first layout, no horizontal scroll at 375px; accessible labels; status conveyed by text not colour alone

E6-S2: backend/pyproject.toml enforces coverage fail_under 80 plus a 95% domain-layer threshold, import-linter contracts (layers + forbidden Repository -> Service), mypy strict, ruff; ac/nfr markers registered; scripts/check_traceability.py scans for AC-01..AC-10 and NFR-01..NFR-08 and exits non-zero on any missing; .github/workflows/ci.yml runs all gates
Group-wide gates mapped to criteria: frontend npm test, npm run lint, npm run typecheck pass; backend lint-imports, mypy --strict src/, ruff check . pass (E6-S2 AC3-4)
